actionCalls.description: Send Email Alert to the newly added Case Team Member when their Case Team Role is one of the secondary engagement roles (Legal, Compliance, Risk, Privacy, Partner, CARE, etc.)
actionCalls.name: Send_Email_Alert_To_Case_Team_Member
actionCalls.label: Send Email Alert To Case Team Member

Flow.interviewLabel: Case Team Member Secondary Role Notification {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
Flow.label: Case Team Member Secondary Role Notification

start.filterFormula: OR( {!$Record.TeamRole.Name} = "Legal Reviewer", {!$Record.TeamRole.Name} = "Legal Approver", {!$Record.TeamRole.Name} = "Compliance Advisor", {!$Record.TeamRole.Name} = "Risk Advisor", {!$Record.TeamRole.Name} = "Privacy Advisor", {!$Record.TeamRole.Name} = "Channel Partner Advisor", {!$Record.TeamRole.Name} = "CARE Onboarding Specialist", {!$Record.TeamRole.Name} = "Operations Coordinator", {!$Record.TeamRole.Name} = "Customer Delivery Liaison", {!$Record.TeamRole.Name} = "Finance Reviewer", {!$Record.TeamRole.Name} = "B2B Analyst", {!$Record.TeamRole.Name} = "Implementation Specialist" )

textTemplates.name: BodyForCaseTeamNotification
textTemplates.text:
You have been added to Case {!$Record.Parent.CaseNumber} ("{!$Record.Parent.Subject}") as {!$Record.TeamRole.Name}.

You can view this Case from the "My Case Teams" list view on the Cases tab.

textTemplates.name: SubjectForCaseTeamNotification
textTemplates.text: You've been added to Case {!$Record.Parent.CaseNumber} as {!$Record.TeamRole.Name}
